full_description: Four distinct object nouns are sampled from one object-familiarity group. An all-Seen scene uses only raw-task-Seen objects; an all-Unseen scene uses only probed raw-task-Unseen objects. The instruction names ONE target by noun only, and the robot lifts it single-arm among three same-group distractors.
schema: {A}=the named target object, filled by play_once with the literal 'the {noun}' (no '/', so replace_placeholders substitutes it verbatim instead of drawing a random objects_description). {a}=arm. The top-level JSON keys 'seen' and 'unseen' below are the instruction-template split, not the object-familiarity split. Templates borrowed from adjust_bottle's orientation-free subset (the same set operate_tabletop's pick branch used, {C}->{A}); bottle-orientation wording was dropped.
preference: borrowed from adjust_bottle native pool; num of words should not exceed 15
seen: Use {a} to hold {A} from the table
Pick up {A} from the table carefully.
Use {a} to pick up {A} from the table.
Raise {A} from the table using the correct arm, {a}.
Grab {A} and lift it upward from the table.
Use the correct arm to pick up {A}.
Pick up {A} from the table using {a}.
Find {A} on the table and raise it using {a}.
unseen: Pick up {A} using the correct arm
Grab {A} on the table and raise it.
